units.source_text: 乐队退出之后，堂上开始管弦之会，又是极有趣味的。

en.t: After the musicians withdrew, a concert of pipes and strings began in the hall, and it too was deeply charming.

units.source_text: 琴瑟之类，皆由皇太子处备办。

en.t: The zithers and other such instruments had all been prepared by the Crown Prince's household.

units.source_text: 朱雀院传下来的琵琶与琴、冷泉帝所赐的筝，其音色都是往日在宫中听惯的。

en.t: The biwa and kin handed down from Suzaku-in, and the koto bestowed by Emperor Reizei, all had tones once familiar from the palace.

units.source_text: 这些乐器难得合奏，无论何时，都令人想起前代的情状和宫中的光景。

en.t: These instruments were seldom played together, and whenever they were, they called to mind the ways of an earlier age and scenes from court life.

units.source_text: 源氏想道：“出家的藤壶母后如果在世而举行四十庆寿，我一定首先主办。

en.t: Genji thought, "If the Empress Mother Fujitsubo, who took religious vows, were still alive and holding her fortieth birthday celebration, I would surely be the first to arrange it.

units.source_text: 可惜当她在世之时，我一点孝心也不曾尽得。”

en.t: How sad that while she lived, I never managed to show her even the least measure of filial devotion."

units.source_text: 他每一念及，总觉遗憾无穷。

en.t: Whenever he thought of it, he felt endless regret.

units.source_text: 冷泉帝想起了母后早死，也常觉得万事毫无意趣，此生寂寞无聊。

en.t: Emperor Reizei, remembering his mother's early death, also often felt that nothing held any interest and that this life was lonely and empty.

units.source_text: 他想至少对于这位六条院主人，须照父子之礼表示孝敬，

en.t: He thought that at least toward the master of Rokujo-in he ought to show reverence according to the rites between father and son,

units.source_text: 然而未便公然实行，为此心中日夜不安。

en.t: but it was not proper to do so openly, and because of this his heart was troubled day and night.

units.source_text: 今年源氏四十庆寿，他本拟以贺寿为由而行幸六条院。

en.t: This year was Genji's fortieth birthday celebration, and Reizei had originally intended to use the occasion as a reason to make an imperial visit to Rokujo-in.

units.source_text: 但源氏认为切不可引起世人烦言，故屡次谏阻。

en.t: But Genji felt that they must on no account invite public gossip, and so he repeatedly advised against it.
Emperor Reizei had no choice but to give it up in disappointment.
